summary: Added gate_positive_good pure function and wired it into Phase 3 per-symbol greedy, combo scoring, fallback, and merged-rule scoring. Added 8 new config keys. Added optional stricter Phase 2 pool admission flag (default OFF). 20 new unit tests + all 94 existing tests pass.
notes_for_reviewer: gate_positive_good is a pure function (no side effects, no engine calls) placed near the top of phase3_rule_set.py after imports.
All gate calls use getattr(_cfg, 'KEY', default) pattern for safe config access.
PHASE2_STRICT_POSITIVE_GOOD defaults to False (not breaking existing pool).
The existing PHASE3_MAX_TRAIN_VAL_GAP_PCT=20.0 gap-reject gate remains in place — the positive-good gate runs BEFORE it.
Lazy import in phase2_support.py avoids circular dependency with phase3_rule_set.
New test file has 20 test cases across 6 test classes covering pure function behavior (14 cases), integration (3 cases), skippable flag (1), importable check (1), and existing gate preservation (1).
